purpose: Directly reconstruct the two mandatory Repair40 physical source targets, 2M1_GE05_mapped and 2Q_GE06_cross, on finer time grids whose nodes exactly contain the original Nt128 two-stage Radau factor-1 stage coordinates, and compare the direct fine-grid target values against the frozen Nt128 PCHIP and Akima stage representations.

direct_time_grids.reason: For the Repair07 two-stage Radau IIA factor-1 tableau c1=1/3 and c2=1, both fine grids contain every Nt128 factor-1 stage coordinate exactly as a grid node.

direct_parent_reconstruction.Z10: Repair21 on-shell reduced H1 canonical solve on each fine grid
direct_parent_reconstruction.Z20: Repair14 Lambda-inclusive H3 source plus Repair18 projected zero-coordinate boundary and Repair07 canonical propagation on each fine grid
direct_parent_reconstruction.q10_q20: Repair27 cancellation-free Repair26 full-history bath parent with Repair24 normalized GE05 q20 equations, Nq=2048, Nx=512, on each fine grid
direct_parent_reconstruction.Z11: Repair32B factor-two corrected H2 reconstruction using the Repair28 R2 tangent parent and the directly reconstructed fine-grid weighted q10

direct_target_definitions.2M1_GE05_mapped: Repair37 m1_mapped_fourier evaluated from directly reconstructed fine-grid B20_linear = X20 - weighted_z20
direct_target_definitions.2Q_GE06_cross: Repair37 exact direct GE06 bilinear cross evaluated from directly reconstructed fine-grid Z10,Z10dot,Z11,Z11dot with the unchanged degree-8 exact FD8 time assembly

comparison_coordinates.set: original Nt128 Repair07 factor-1 Radau stage coordinates
comparison_coordinates.direct_fine_grid_lookup: exact integer-node lookup only; no target-source interpolation
frozen_comparators: PCHIP of frozen Repair37 Nt128 target nodes
AKIMA of frozen Repair37 Nt128 target nodes

resolution_gates.threshold_source: The 5e-3 ceiling is inherited from the certified parent time-resolution controls; it is not chosen from Repair41 output.

diagnostic_routes.DIRECT_TARGET_REFERENCE_RESOLVED: All implementation reproduction and fine382-vs-fine763 resolution gates pass. Freeze the direct763 target reference and its comparison to PCHIP/Akima; Repair42 may test H4 propagation with the direct target-stage corrections.
diagnostic_routes.DIRECT_TARGET_REFERENCE_UNRESOLVED: Implementation reproduction passes but at least one inherited 5e-3 fine-grid resolution gate fails. Freeze and increase only target-parent time resolution before any H4 reclosure.
diagnostic_routes.IMPLEMENTATION_FAIL: Frozen bindings, Nt128 formula reproduction, exact stage-node mapping or finiteness fails. Repair41 may be repaired without changing this preregistered contract.
